Treatment summary
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes. The reported
mechanism, including the direction of impact and the force involved, is consistent with the concussion diagnosed at intake, and
the symptoms described at presentation align with that mechanism. Over the course of 16 visits, care followed a typical
progression, beginning with symptom monitoring, vestibular and cognitive assessment, and graded activity guidance, then
tapering in frequency as the patient's headaches, light sensitivity, and concentration difficulties improved. Imaging and
neurological examination findings clearly support the diagnosis. The patient reports no prior injury to the head or neck region,
and none appears in available records. Billing records show two similar charges submitted on the same day, which are currently
under review to confirm they reflect separate, appropriate services. Current sattus is improving, with return to work planned
pending final reassessment.
